snippet.title: BARABIZNA - Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on steam now:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3457800/BARABIZNA

And try it on itch.io:
https://cepela.itch.io/barabizna

BARABIZNA is a short, spine-chilling horror game set in a creepy old house. Your mission: find and collect all the hidden items before it's too late. But beware... you're not alone.
